remarks: This charming 3-bedroom, 3-bath rental offers a townhouse feel w/ plenty of space to spread out & make it your own. With four levels of living space, you'll find room for everything you need, plus great storage options to keep you organized. The cozy compact kitchen is perfect for whipping up your favorite meals, & flows seamlessly into the inviting living area, making it easy to entertain or relax. Go outside to your private deck, where you can enjoy morning coffee or unwind after a long day in your own outdoor retreat. Just a stone's throw from the Dorothy Hamill Skating Rink, you'll have plenty of opportunities for fun & recreation right at your doorstep. This rental is not just a place to live; it's a place to create lasting memories. Don't miss out on this wonderful opportunity!
